correctness.rationale: Complete analytic proof: the antipodal-pair lemma yields the exact factor-zero congruence, the Fourier product has a nonzero convergent tail, the two live radix states and exact transition counts yield the rational first-zero PGF, and a separate post-hit argument proves at most two zero levels and their exact density. A shrinking periodic-cylinder envelope proves existence of ordinary centered-box lattice density. The standard-library checker independently compared complete cyclotomic-field tests at four finite resolution pairs; finite checks do not prove arbitrary parameters.

value.rationale: Natural spectral invariant: integer Fourier-null density measures the asymptotic null-mode proportion of convolution by a canonical spatial simplex IFS measure. The closed first-hit generating function and sharp at-most-two-level law resolve all radix scales, with a two-pole change at even b>2 and an odd/even phase boundary. The exact b=4 density 47/315 and double density 1/315 are intrinsically motivated specializations, not an arbitrary finite sample; the structural derivation can guide comparisons of fractal convolution operators.
